test_case.test_name: DC-SCM rear USB2 slots1-2 40C/-5% rails 12-hour stress
test_case.purpose: Verify both DC-SCM rear USB2 paths sustain 12-hour operation under measured undervoltage without hub, link, integrity or platform errors.
required_package: Calibrated load-point rail/chamber limits and ramp
test_case.test_command: Operator records module/connector topology and baseline, ramps to measured 40C/-5% rails, confirms both USB2 paths, runs the complete attributable 12-hour SST profile with per-port/controller/environment evidence, then restores nominal conditions and verifies DC-SCM/system health.
test_case.expected_result: Both rear ports remain correctly enumerated and error-free for the full in-tolerance run with no disallowed hub reset, data error, reconnect or SEL/kernel event; restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact module and both ports, complete duration, low-rail trace and separate evidence. Front ports, one rear port, +5%/nominal or aggregate-only evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Independent low-rail measurement and controlled ramp
Abort on hub brownout, link/data/system or environment fault
Preserve evidence; restore nominal; no retry
test_case.recovery: Stop on either-port/controller fault, preserve module/per-port evidence, ramp safely to nominal, verify DC-SCM/system and do not automatically rerun.
